name: Sealed Gate of Dragonkin
description: A narrow stair descends into a half-buried antechamber where a basalt gate waits beneath a carved dragon skull. Old torch brackets line the walls, and the air tastes of dust, cold iron, and distant smoke.
challenges: The basalt gate is locked by three rotating stone rings marked with claw, flame, and crown symbols.
A careless touch on the wrong ring releases a burst of choking ash from vents in the floor.
clues: A cracked inscription reads: 'Claw serves flame; flame bows to crown.'
Fresh scratches near the lowest ring suggest small clawed hands recently forced the mechanism.
loot: A tarnished bronze key shaped like a dragon talon.

founding.purpose: To bar unworthy thieves from the tomb's inner sanctum.

features.name: Basalt Gate
features.description: A heavy black stone door whose rings must be aligned before it will open.

features.name: Ash Vents
features.description: Thin slits in the floor that cough bitter grey ash when the gate is disturbed.

completion.objective: Open the basalt gate and pass into the Hall of Fallen Scales.
signals: the player passes through the gate
the player enters the hall beyond
